parts:
Coming from a Christian point of view, when someone says, *“I don’t know what I believe in,”* you can respond with honesty, grace, and curiosity. Here’s a heartfelt yet respectful way you might reply:

---

**"I get that—faith, God, purpose… those are big questions, and it makes sense to wrestle with them. I believe in Jesus because He met me where I was, not where I thought I had to be. It wasn’t about religion or rules—it was about relationship. And if you’re ever open to talking more about it, I’d love to share what that’s looked like in my life. No pressure, just real conversation."**

---

You can adjust based on your relationship and the vibe of the moment. The key is to offer truth without trying to convince—let your peace and love do the talking. Often, people aren’t looking for a lecture; they’re looking to be seen, heard, and invited.
